name: Docker Run / Compose Converter
description: Convert between a docker run command and a Compose file, covering ports, environment variables, volumes, networks and the start command.

hints.input: Paste a docker run command or a Compose file; the direction is detected from the input and corrected automatically when it does not match. The conversion is pure text processing and never talks to a daemon.
hints.serviceName: Leave it empty to derive the name from the image.
hints.strict: Fail on unsupported options or keys instead of ignoring them.

faq.q: Which docker run options are supported?
faq.a: Name, ports, environment, volumes, networks, restart policy, entrypoint, working dir, user, hostname, privileged, capabilities, labels, tmpfs, devices, memory and CPU. Anything else is ignored and listed.

faq.q: Why are some options left out?
faq.a: Options such as --env-file, --mount, healthcheck, depends_on and build have no equivalent on the other side. They are listed by name, and their values are never echoed back.

faq.q: Can I use the output as is?
faq.a: This is a syntax-level conversion. Validate it with docker compose config, and fill in networks, volumes and health checks as needed.
